plugins.name: AI Catalog
plugins.summary: AI-assisted product entry and catalogue cleanup.
plugins.description: Identify a part from its code, suggest a category, dup-check and generate a barcode, cost from markup, set quantity, and print labels — for new products or a batch Optimize pass over the existing catalogue. Works via API or manual paste.

plugins.name: Alternatives
plugins.summary: Group interchangeable products into quality tiers.
plugins.description: Group-aware counter search, alternative suggestions with a till tier pin, and reorder-by-alternatives.

plugins.name: Clearance
plugins.description: Flags stale items (has stock, no sale in N days) and lots expiring soon, suggests a margin-safe markdown the owner approves and applies at the till, and lists dead stock for one-click disable.

plugins.name: Combos
plugins.description: A group of products (or one product in bulk, e.g. buy-3-get-1-free) with a percent or fixed discount, added in one tap as real discounted lines that deplete stock and return like normal sales.

plugins.name: Print & Copy Counter
plugins.summary: Metered photocopy, print, laminate and bind jobs.
plugins.description: Jobs priced by size, colour and side with quantity tiers (consuming paper/film from stock), custom labour jobs with per-worker payout, reversal and own-use, plus a receipts tab, activity feed and revenue/consumables/labour report.

plugins.name: Product Plus
plugins.description: Text, number, yes/no and dropdown fields with per-field required / searchable / visibility settings — shown on the product form, stock intake and till info popup, usable as label lines and searchable across till and lists.

plugins.name: Mobile Recharge
plugins.description: Airtime reload, cash-in/out, bill pay, supplier float top-ups, wallet tender for sales, and per-device float reconciliation.

plugins.name: Repairs
plugins.summary: Track device repair jobs drop-off to pickup.
plugins.description: Parts and labour/charges, deposits, warranty, customer register and a repair slip. Settles as a normal sale at the till; the admin pays outside repairers from any cash location.

plugins.name: Customer Requests
plugins.description: Cashiers jot down items the shop doesn't carry yet; the admin reviews the list and can promote a request into a real product to stock.
